description: WorkOS shared Renovate preset. Hardens GitHub Actions usage with SHA-pinned digests tracked by semver tag, a 7-day minimum release age, and grouped/automerged minor & patch updates. See README for details.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Constrain security-fix PRs to the same schedule as regular updates (Renovate's built-in default is schedule:[] — any time) and to the same 7-day minimum release age (built-in default is minimumReleaseAge:null — propose immediately). The age constraint matters because pnpm's minimum-release-age in workos/workos common/config/rush/.npmrc refuses to install versions younger than 7 days regardless of what Renovate proposes: a security PR for a fresher fix is guaranteed to fail its lockfile update until the version ages. Aligning the gates means the PR is only opened once it is actually installable.

packageRules.description: Group and automerge minor/patch GitHub Actions updates. helpers:pinGitHubActionDigestsToSemver makes these resolve to a semver tag, which carries a release timestamp, so the 7-day minimum release age is genuinely enforced before automerge.

Do not open bare digest re-points (same tag, new commit) for GitHub Actions. The github-tags datasource attaches no timestamp to a digest, so minimumReleaseAgeBehaviour:timestamp-required holds these PRs pending forever — and automerging them anyway would merge a commit of unknown age, which is exactly the tag-hijack shape SHA pinning defends against. Pinned SHAs move only as part of an aged semver update; a re-pointed tag is caught by the security team's review instead.

Automerge the initial pin of an action with no minimum release age. A pin replaces a floating tag with the SHA that tag already resolves to, so it introduces no new code — it freezes what every run is executing today. Waiting 7 days to pin means continuing to run the floating tag in the meantime, which is strictly worse.
Do not open major GitHub Actions updates. Major action bumps often carry breaking changes and must be performed manually.
Disable major and minor updates for software dependencies — patch-only policy.

Automerge patch updates for software dependencies after minimum release age. Group by dependency name so monorepos with version-consistency policies (e.g. Rush) get a single PR per dependency across all packages.
Skip internal/private Docker registries that Renovate cannot resolve (dhi.io and ghcr.io/workos).
